blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

blocks.text: A townhome is a ground-level home that is part of a complex, and in BC it is usually owned within a strata. What is on offer in Brentwood Park at any moment depends on the live listings, which is where Jared starts when he sets up a search.
Townhomes or condos in Brentwood Park?
Most of the attached homes in Brentwood Park are listed in the condo and townhome line together. The condo page has the month-by-month table; the houses page has the 21 detached listings.
Brentwood Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

14 townhomes sold in Brentwood Park with a median price of $1,070,000 (the middle half sold between $878,350 and $1,236,000), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 98.3% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $671 per square foot, a median year built of 2018 and a median strata fee of $367 a month.

A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: The reports count townhomes and condos together: 360 listed in Brentwood Park at the end of September 2026. A townhome-only count needs the sold and active listing export from Jared’s board system, so ask him for what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Brentwood Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for townhomes?
faq.a: For condos and townhomes together the sales ratio in September 2026 was 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How does Brentwood Park compare with other Burnaby communities for attached homes?
faq.a: It ranked number 1 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings in September 2026.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate townhomes from condos?
faq.a: The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so the month-by-month table covers both. The sold-price section further down separates them, using closed sales from Jared’s MLS® system (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).

faq.q: Where are the Brentwood Park houses and condos?
faq.a: Houses and condos each have their own page, and the Brentwood Park guide covers the neighbourhood as a whole.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Brentwood Park sell for?
faq.a: 14 townhomes sold in Brentwood Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,070,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.3% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
